Name: Junimo Orchestra
Author: ifuwasacat
Description:
[size=5][b]Junimo Orchestra — walk past a block and it plays.[/b][/size]
17 instrument blocks that play every General MIDI instrument. Lay a row of them on the ground and walk along it: it's a tune, in time with your steps.

[b][url=https://youtu.be/miqboRnjmHk]WATCH THE TRAILER[/url][/b] |  [url=https://github.com/link1412/JunimoStudio]Source[/url]

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/link1412/JunimoStudio/v1.0.0/JunimoOrchestra/docs/screenshots/blocks.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]17 blocks, 274 sounds.[/b] The 16 General MIDI families and a drum kit. The built-in SoundFont, GeneralUser GS, has all 128 GM instruments, 133 variations and 13 drum kits.[/*]
[*][b]Walk past to play.[/b] From 1 to 8 tiles away in a straight line, and villagers and animals can set blocks off too. The sound fades and pans with distance, and little notes float up.[/*]
[*][b]A tuner for every block[/b] (right-click it). Pick an instrument; write notes by octave and note name, with lengths and delays the way a score writes them, or in the full piano roll (all 128 pitches, velocity and exact MIDI ticks, up to 64 notes a block); add reverb, chorus, vibrato and pan.[/*]
[*][b]Your own walking speed.[/b] The [ and ] keys walk slower and faster, \ goes back to 100%. At 100% a tile is a sixteenth note at 75 BPM; slow down for a ballad.[/*]
[*][b]Junimos.[/b] Restore the Community Center and the Junimos leave you three recipes: Classical Junimos, Junimo Musicians and Band Junimos. They take up whatever instrument you tune them to.[/*]
[*][b]Copy and paste[/b] a block's setup, also through the clipboard, to send to a friend.[/*]
[*][b]Your own SoundFonts and pictures[/b] go in a folder that updates never touch. Content Patcher can edit the pictures too.[/*]
[*]English and Chinese. Generic Mod Config Menu is supported (optional).[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53635/53635-1791545709-295153753.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Downloads[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Junimo Orchestra 1.0.0[/b]: the mod. It unzips into two folders: JunimoOrchestra, the mod, and [JO] Custom, for your own SoundFonts and pictures.[/*]
[*][b]Example save[/b] (optional): Maestro's farm, with four rows of tunes below the house: Für Elise (two ways), Debussy's First Arabesque and Mozart's Eine kleine Nachtmusik. Unzip it into your Saves folder (%AppData%\StardewValley\Saves on Windows, ~/.config/StardewValley/Saves on macOS and Linux), load the farm and run along each path from left to right at 100% speed.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
1. Install SMAPI 4.0 or later (Stardew Valley 1.6).
2. Unzip the mod into Mods.
3. Start the game. The 17 recipes are in the crafting menu: 5 wood and 5 fiber make 100 blocks.

[size=4][b]Playing[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Walk next to a block: it plays. Standing still doesn't repeat it.[/*]
[*]Hover a block: its instrument and notes, and the tiles that set it off.[/*]
[*]Right-click a block: the tuner. Space plays the block.[/*]
[*]The [ and ] keys: walk slower and faster (25–200%; with Shift, 5% at a time). \ goes back to 100%.[/*]
[/list]A block can also hold a whole bar at its own tempo: put the next block where the next bar starts. Blocks keep their tune when you pick them up.

[size=4][b]Your own SoundFonts and pictures[/b][/size]
They go in Mods/[JO] Custom; its README.txt has the details.
[list]
[*][b]soundfonts/[/b]: .sf2 files show up in the tuner's Global tab. Instrument names, variations and drum kits follow the SoundFont. Each player picks their own.[/*]
[*][b]textures/[/b]: a PNG with the same name and size as one in JunimoOrchestra/assets/textures replaces it: the blocks, the Junimos, the item icons, the panel, the note particles. With Content Patcher, edit Mods/link1412.JunimoOrchestra/Blocks, Items, Classical, Band, Orchestra, UI and Fx.[/*]
[*]To share a pack, copy the folder and give the copy a name and UniqueID of its own.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 with SMAPI 4.0+, mouse and keyboard (no gamepad controls in the tuner yet). Tested on macOS with SMAPI 4.4.0 and Stardew Valley 1.6.15; the sound goes through the game's own audio output, so Windows and Linux should work the same.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer hasn't been tested much yet. Everyone with the mod hears the same blocks; the save's tempo, reach, reverb space and key are the host's.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Future plans[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Relay: blocks that set off their neighbours, for music machines that play themselves.[/*]
[*]Lay a MIDI file out as a row of blocks.[/*]
[*]Play and record blocks from a MIDI keyboard.[/*]
[*]Gamepad controls in the tuner; SF3 SoundFonts.[/*]
[*]Looking into: VST3 instruments.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]See also[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52634]Farm x N[/url]: make your farm as big as you like. The trailer was filmed on one.

[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
By ifuwasacat / link1412. SoundFont: GeneralUser GS v2.0.3 by S. Christian Collins. Synthesizer: MeltySynth 2.4.1 by Nobuaki Tanaka (MIT license), with a few changes, built into Junimo.Engine.dll under its own name so it never clashes with another mod's copy. The trailer's music is Grieg's In the Hall of the Mountain King (public domain), played by the blocks. Stardew Valley and its Junimos belong to ConcernedApe and are not covered by the MIT license. Thanks to SMAPI.

[size=4][b]中文说明[/b][/size]
[b]祝尼魔乐团：走过方块，它就会响。[/b]
17 种乐器方块，覆盖全部 General MIDI 音色。在地上摆一排，走一遍就是一首曲子。中文视频：[url=https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1UipM6FEue]B 站[/url]
[list]
[*]17 种方块、274 种音色：自带 GeneralUser GS 音色库，128 个 GM 音色、133 个变体、13 套鼓组。[/*]
[*]走过就响：直线上 1–8 格都能触发，村民和小动物也能触发；声音随距离变小、随位置分左右。[/*]
[*]调音面板（右键方块）：选音色；简化音符页按八度和音名选音，像照着乐谱填，也有完整的钢琴卷帘；还能调混响、合唱、颤音、声像。[/*]
[*]自己调走路速度：[ 慢一点，] 快一点，\ 回到 100%。[/*]
[*]修好社区中心后解锁三种祝尼魔乐手，调成什么乐器就换上什么乐器。[/*]
[*]音色库和贴图都能换：.sf2 放进 [JO] Custom/soundfonts，同名同尺寸的 png 放进 [JO] Custom/textures；更新不会动这个文件夹，也支持 Content Patcher。[/*]
[/list]安装：装好 SMAPI 4.0+（星露谷 1.6），把主文件解压到 Mods（会得到 JunimoOrchestra 和 [JO] Custom 两个文件夹），启动游戏，配方在制作菜单里：5 木材 + 5 纤维做 100 个方块。
示例存档（可选文件）：解压到存档文件夹，载入 Maestro 的农场，用 100% 的速度沿着每条小路从左往右跑。
在 macOS 上用 SMAPI 4.4.0 + 星露谷 1.6.15 测过；联机还没有充分测试。
未来计划：方块接力、导入 MIDI 文件、MIDI 键盘、手柄、SF3；在研究：VST3 乐器。
